mentions.name: Geneva Business Messaging
mentions.description: A messaging platform that centralizes, persists, and when necessary escalates critical interactions between large companies and their partners, focused on genuine collaborative cross-company work in fields like engineering, logistics, and security rather than spam, marketing, or sales.
mentions.problem: Frequent B2B messaging apps serve spam, marketing, and sales purposes rather than critical collaborative cross-company work.
mentions.audience: large companies and their partners working in fields like engineering, logistics, or security
mentions.source_excerpt:
We're Geneva Business Messaging, a tool to centralize, persist, and if necessary escalate critical interactions between large companies and their partners. For actual collaborative cross-company work in fields like engineering, logistics, or security - not spam, marketing, sales, or the other frequent purposes of B2B apps.

We're at genevabm.com if you want to check it out!
